description: Curated workflow families. Conceptual states are not new wire enums; source-index.json provides broader candidate evidence.

workflows.transitions: boot → restoring → authenticated / signed-out / offline-retry
workflows.decision: Preserve saved credentials on temporary failure. Keep current session security; follow-up: generation-scoped restore/logout.

workflows.transitions: access-valid → expired → refreshing → rotated / rejected / retryable; refresh row live → revoked / expired
workflows.decision: Atomic server rotation, one stored pair; never add unbounded automatic mutation retries. Follow-up: scope in-flight refresh to session generation.

workflows.transitions: login ↔ forgot; editing → submitting → success / error
workflows.decision: Keep mode separate from request state; disable repeated submissions synchronously when refactoring.

workflows.transitions: name → age → country → purpose → optional identity → account → photo → home
workflows.decision: Account creation is an irreversible boundary within the wizard; back navigation must not create a second account. Keep current ordering; follow-up guards around post-create back/retry.

workflows.transitions: issued → expired / consumed; form ready → submitting → accepted / invalid
workflows.decision: Server validates purpose, expiry and consumption; reset changes auth_version transactionally. Preserve migration and rollback requirements.

workflows.transitions: active → suspended / deleted; inactivity → cleanup
workflows.decision: Server rejects suspended/deleted users; deletion is not a reversible UI toggle. Keep.

workflows.transitions: draft → saving → saved / error; incomplete → eligible; dating off ↔ on
workflows.decision: Name/photo/country, adult eligibility and mutual interest remain backend rules. Keep computed eligibility separate from form state.

workflows.transitions: picking → cancelled / uploading → committed / failed
workflows.decision: Do not advertise a photo as saved before server acknowledgement; preserve size/type checks. Keep.

workflows.transitions: prelaunch → region-open; admin override
workflows.decision: Server controls launch and country thresholds; client projections must not unlock matching. Keep.

workflows.transitions: loading → pending votes → complete/results → next UTC drop
workflows.decision: Same daily set for all; skip does not count as a rating. Keep.

workflows.transitions: idle → dragging → committing animation → local removal/reveal → persisted / rollback
workflows.decision: Optimistic queue restores the film on failure. Follow-up: reconcile parent refresh with pending ratings; do not serialize gestures unnecessarily.

workflows.transitions: collection/query selected → loading → results / empty / error
workflows.decision: Latest query should own results. Follow-up: request generation or abort to prevent old search replacement.

workflows.transitions: unrated → love / hate / skip; favourite selected / cleared; fresh → derived personality
workflows.decision: Server ratings are canonical; personality and compatibility remain derived, not writable lifecycle fields. Keep.

workflows.transitions: not-played → played-today → consecutive / lapsed; countdown → next drop
workflows.decision: Preserve UTC day rules and idempotent same-day play. Keep.

workflows.transitions: loading → launch-gated / profile-incomplete / candidate / exhausted / daily-limit / error
workflows.decision: API controls caps and eligibility. Follow-up: replace coupled deck flags with a union after acceptance tests.

workflows.transitions: candidate → like/pass → next candidate; reciprocal like → match → overlay dismissed/chat
workflows.decision: Preserve mutual-interest, block and region filters; no speculative matching in UI. Keep.

workflows.transitions: loading → intro → waiting → open; any → closed
workflows.decision: **Changed:** one typed mobile access state, missing waitingOnPeer returned by both API aliases, send disabled while loading/waiting/closed, same-tick send lock, terminal close preserved. API still enforces permission.

workflows.transitions: disconnected → subscribed / fallback polling; fetching → merging; unread → read
workflows.decision: **Changed:** conversation/account keyed screen, stale gate responses ignored, visible retry. Follow-up: full history/poll ordering, cursor ties, and backend first-hello concurrency need dedicated tests.

workflows.transitions: draft → submitting → acknowledged / error
workflows.decision: **Changed:** consume intro permission on successful send before follow-up fetch; retain failed draft. Network ambiguity still needs backend idempotency before automatic retries.

workflows.transitions: code editing → adding → friends / invalid; friend ↔ removed; comparison loading → result/error
workflows.decision: Reciprocal rows and block eligibility are server-owned; follow-up: transactional reciprocal removal.

workflows.transitions: sheet closed → draft → sending → reported; optional block → conversation closed
workflows.decision: Preserve separate report/block outcomes; partial success must not silently repeat a report. Keep; audit transactional behavior separately.

workflows.transitions: queue open → reviewing → resolved/dismissed; report open → reviewed/dismissed; identity unverified/pending/verified/rejected
workflows.decision: Existing enum sets are allowed values, not necessarily enforced transition graphs. Follow-up: atomic queue/report mapping and explicit admin transition policy.

workflows.transitions: editing → sending → sent/error; admin new → read → done
workflows.decision: Keep form state independent of moderation status; duplicate-submit protection is a follow-up.

workflows.transitions: billing-disabled / configured; inactive → active → expired / revoked
workflows.decision: Server entitlement and time are authoritative; purchase/restore remains a release gate. Keep; no payment behavior changed.

workflows.transitions: permission unset/denied/granted → device token registered → removed; notification → deep link
workflows.decision: Token belongs to account; sign-out revocation and foreground/background transitions need device testing. Keep.

workflows.transitions: fetch → visible/error; copy → copied; image loading → loaded/fallback
workflows.decision: Simple copy/image booleans stay local; no reducer needed.

workflows.transitions: idle/loading → data/empty/error; edit → submit → success/error; sheet open ↔ closed
workflows.decision: A lifecycle family instantiated independently per screen, not one global machine. Keep selection/text/toggle fields simple; scope async results to resource/account.

workflows.transitions: configured/unconfigured; live/ready/degraded; export → signed build → staging → release
workflows.decision: Preserve release gates. Passing unit tests is not a production-readiness state.
